title: Paintings, drawings and pastels; original engravings, prints and lithographs; original sculptures and statuary, in any material

review.classification: UNSD CPC 3.0 p. 197 identifies paintings and other original graphic works at 38961. Hand creation and actual physical transfer distinguish the selected subset from printed picture reproductions at 32540, licensing at 73320 and artist services at 96320. Original engravings can also fall under the broader code. The physical-object and contract tests are important for mixed orders.
review.route_evidence: Winsor & Newton documents cotton supports available pre-primed. Gamblin documents the supplied oil colours, direct solvent-free oil painting and separate safflower brush-cleaning supplies. Primary sources justify a possible narrow route. A studio’s exact materials, quantities, drying conditions, release criterion and medium must be evidenced separately.
review.measurement_and_allocation: Reviewed bilingual rules for actual number and complete release mass of indivisible works, complete supplied canvas/stretcher and commercial colours, unused palette stock, rejected attempts and rework. Confirmed distinct whole-object and attributed accounts, original manufacturing burdens retained through later services, and independent evidence for oxidative uptake and water change. Financial value and stylistic significance do not make works functionally comparable.
review.maturity: The study requires complete identity and actual studio data. The verified archived measurement supports do not qualify the reference artwork as a particular native flow. Scientific and translation approvals remain open.
